Breast Reduction Surgery in Bangalore for Size, Comfort and Proportion

Breast reduction removes selected breast tissue, fat and skin to reduce breast weight and reshape the breast. Patients may seek surgery for neck or back discomfort, shoulder-groove pressure, skin irritation, exercise limitation or body-proportion concerns. NeoSculpt6 plans reduction around breast size, tissue quality, nipple position, asymmetry, symptoms and the amount of reduction that can be achieved safely.

What Is BREAST REDUCTION SURGERY?

Breast reduction, or reduction mammoplasty, removes selected breast tissue, fat and skin and reshapes the remaining breast to reduce size and weight. The nipple-areola complex is usually kept attached to a tissue pedicle that preserves blood supply while it is moved to a position suited to the new breast shape. Liposuction may assist contouring in selected areas but does not replace tissue excision when a large amount of glandular tissue or skin must be removed. Scar pattern varies with breast size, the amount of reduction and the technique used; scars are permanent but usually change and mature over time. The procedure may improve heaviness and related symptoms, but individual outcomes and sensation changes cannot be guaranteed.

Balance Symptom Relief with a Sustainable Breast Shape

The surgeon reviews breast volume, skin envelope, nipple position, asymmetry and symptoms such as pain, rashes or activity limitation. Weight stability, pregnancy plans and breastfeeding goals are also important.

The consultation explains expected scar patterns, nipple repositioning, the possibility of sensation or breastfeeding changes and why an exact postoperative cup size cannot be guaranteed.

OUR PROCESS

OUR BREAST REDUCTION PROCESS

Size, skin, nipple position, asymmetry and physical symptoms are reviewed.

The surgeon estimates tissue removal and selects a scar pattern and nipple-support technique.

Medical history, breast imaging when appropriate, tests and anaesthesia planning are completed.

Excess tissue is removed and the breast and nipple are reshaped.

Dressings, support bra, wound care and lifting restrictions are explained.

Healing, circulation, sensation and breast symmetry are monitored.

Swelling settles and scars mature over several months.

WHO CAN BENEFIT FROM BREAST REDUCTION?

  • Patients with Neck, Shoulder or Back Discomfort

    Large breast weight can contribute to physical symptoms in selected patients.

  • Patients with Shoulder-Groove or Skin Irritation

    Bra pressure and moisture beneath the breast can cause discomfort and recurrent irritation.

  • Patients Limited in Exercise or Clothing

    Reduction may improve comfort during physical activity and broaden clothing options.

  • Patients Seeking Better Breast Proportion

    Size reduction and reshaping can improve proportion when breast volume feels excessive. Smoking, unstable weight, future pregnancy plans and uncontrolled medical conditions can alter timing or risk.

Breast Reduction Surgery is planned around anatomy, proportion, safety, recovery and realistic outcome expectations.

Breast Reduction Surgery Cost and Consultation in Bangalore

Cost depends on breast size, amount of reduction, technique, anaesthesia, facility and whether liposuction or asymmetry correction is included.

  1. 01

    Amount of Tissue and Skin Removal

    Larger reductions generally require more operative work.

  2. 02

    Scar and Pedicle Technique

    Anatomy determines the safest reshaping approach.

  3. 03

    Additional Liposuction or Asymmetry Work

    Selected lateral-chest liposuction or additional work to improve asymmetry can increase operative time and complexity. It is included only when it contributes to the agreed breast-reduction plan.

  4. 04

    Facility and Follow-Up

    The written estimate should clarify the surgical facility, anaesthesia, support garments, planned postoperative reviews and any pathology requirements that apply to the procedure.
